Name: SDV Fairydew Valley
Author: PlantishFellow
Description:
All of the datable cast have been reskinned (both portraits and sprites) to fantasy creatures!
Abigail - Elf
Alex - Orc
Elliott - Seamonster
Emily - Fairy
Haley - Princess
Harvey - Faun
Leah - Fox girl
Maru - Unicorn
Penny - Mushroom Dwarf
Sam - Teifling
Sebastian - Elf
Shane - Dragon

That and the main houses that players can live in have been changed to fit a fantasy aesthetic
Main House, Log Cabin, Stone Cabin and Plank Cabin

Making this was honestly really fun, so I'll continue to make more fantasy sprites for the rest of the cast + eventually change up the farm animals, villager houses and some crops/plants.

Downloads.Description:
SMAPI and ContentPatcher are required

- Install the latest version of

SMAPI https://smapi.io/

and

ContentPatcher https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915

- Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods
